headline: Linn of Mercy Re-ignites as Heavy Fighting Engulfs Northern Fronts
war_summary: Strategic base transactions have abruptly re-ignited in Linn of Mercy over the past two hours, with three direct shifts centered around Lathair amid mounting casualty rates. Meanwhile, Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse remain the bloodiest sectors on the map, both generating surging butcher's bills exceeding fifteen hundred combined losses per sector in the latest two-hour stretch as positions around World's End, Crow's Nest, and Frostmarch stay heavily contested. By contrast, the recent flare-up in Dead Lands has cooled considerably, registering minimal combat following earlier disputes at Callahan's Gate, and momentum in Nevish Line has likewise tapered off. To the east, Callahan's Passage displays a sharp upward spike in casualty acceleration, drawing hundreds of fresh troops into the fray. Elsewhere, previously volatile positions across Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, and the maritime flanks have settled into relative stability without immediate territorial shifts.
